title: Transcriptome revealed the molecular mechanism of Glycyrrhiza inflata root to maintain growth and development, absorb and distribute ions under salt stress.
authors: Xu, Ying; Lu, Jia-Hui; Zhang, Jia-de; Liu, Deng-Kui; Wang, Yue; Niu, Qing-Dong; Huang, Dan-Dan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组分析盐胁迫下胀果甘草根部的离子吸收与基因表达变化，虽涉及转录因子家族，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，属纯转录组实验，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Soil salinization extensively hampers the growth, yield, and quality of crops worldwide. The most effective strategies to counter this problem are a) development of crop cultivars with high salt tolerance and b) the plantation of salt-tolerant crops. Glycyrrhiza inflata, a traditional Chinese medicinal and primitive plant with salt tolerance and economic value, is among the most promising crops for improving saline-alkali wasteland. However, the underlying molecular mechanisms for the adaptive response of G. inflata to salinity stress remain largely unknown. RESULT: G. inflata retained a high concentration of Na(+) in roots and maintained the absorption of K(+), Ca(2+), and Mg(2+) under 150 mM NaCl induced salt stress. Transcriptomic analysis of G. inflata roots at different time points of salt stress (0 min, 30 min, and 24 h) was performed, which resulted in 70.77 Gb of clean data. Compared with the control, we detected 2645 and 574 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) at 30 min and 24 h post-salt-stress induction, respectively. Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analyses revealed that G. inflata response to salt stress post 30 min and 24 h was remarkably distinct. Genes that were differentially expressed at 30 min post-salt stress induction were enriched in signal transduction, secondary metabolite synthesis, and ion transport. However, genes that were differentially expressed at 24 h post-salt-stress induction were enriched in phenylpropane biosynthesis and metabolism, fatty acid metabolism, glycerol metabolism, hormone signal transduction, wax, cutin, and cork biosynthesis. Besides, a total of 334 transcription factors (TFs) were altered in response to 30 min and 24 h of salt stress. Most of these TFs belonged to the MYB, WRKY, AP2-EREBP, C2H2, bHLH, bZIP, and NAC families. CONCLUSION: For the first time, this study elucidated the salt tolerance in G. inflata at the molecular level, including the activation of signaling pathways and genes that regulate the absorption and distribution of ions and root growth in G. inflata under salt stress conditions. These findings enhanced our understanding of the G. inflata salt tolerance and provided a theoretical basis for cultivating salt-tolerant crop varieties.
abstract_zh: 背景：土壤盐渍化在全球范围内严重阻碍作物的生长、产量和品质。应对这一问题最有效的策略是：a) 培育高耐盐性的作物品种，b) 种植耐盐作物。胀果甘草（Glycyrrhiza inflata）是一种具有耐盐性和经济价值的传统中药材及原始植物，是改良盐碱荒地最有前景的作物之一。然而，胀果甘草对盐胁迫适应性反应的潜在分子机制仍 largely 未知。结果：在150 mM NaCl诱导的盐胁迫下，胀果甘草在根部保留了高浓度的Na(+)，并维持了对K(+)、Ca(2+)和Mg(2+)的吸收。对盐胁迫不同时间点（0分钟、30分钟和24小时）的胀果甘草根部进行了转录组分析，获得了70.77 Gb的清洁数据。与对照相比，在盐胁迫诱导后30分钟和24小时分别检测到2645和574个差异表达基因（DEGs）。基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路分析显示，胀果甘草在盐胁迫后30分钟和24小时的响应显著不同。盐胁迫诱导后30分钟差异表达的基因富集于信号转导、次生代谢物合成和离子转运。然而，盐胁迫诱导后24小时差异表达的基因富集于苯丙烷生物合成与代谢、脂肪酸代谢、甘油代谢、激素信号转导、蜡质、角质和软木脂生物合成。此外，共有334个转录因子（TFs）在响应30分钟和24小时盐胁迫时发生改变。这些转录因子大多属于MYB、WRKY、AP2-EREBP、C2H2、bHLH、bZIP和NAC家族。结论：本研究首次在分子水平上阐明了胀果甘草的耐盐性，包括在盐胁迫条件下激活信号通路和调控离子吸收、分布及根部生长的基因。这些发现增进了我们对胀果甘草耐盐性的理解，并为培育耐盐作物品种提供了理论基础。
